supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Moderate lateral extension visible beyond the outer corners of the eyes.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned muzzle and the dark-toned cheek and periocular regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a pronounced structural droop exposing internal mouth contents.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent pale depigmentation spot on the bridge of the nose.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, light-colored masticated bolus held in the mouth, causing outward protrusion of the lips.
